title: What Bizinator and Best Deal On Bot are
body:
Best Deal On (bestdealon.app) publishes local business profiles written by the businesses themselves: hours, specials, FAQs and contact details that people, search engines and AI assistants can trust. Each profile has a web page, a machine-readable JSON profile and an RSS feed. Best Deal On is by Quanta X Technology LLC.

Best Deal On Bot is a Chrome browser extension that works with Grok Bot. It keeps a business's Best Deal On page up to date, gives one source of truth for hours, specials, FAQs and links, and backs up the business's Grok Bot bots. The page updates when you sync.

Bizinator is a zero-person-company business harness from Quanta X Technology. It is built on the Callbots AI agent stack, so a business can be run by AI agents. Bizinator and Promptinator are Best Deal On products. The phone assistant is powered by Callbots.org.

title: How to get started and install
body:
Best Deal On Bot is not in the Chrome Web Store yet. During early access, Quanta X Technology staff send the extension folder to approved businesses. Ask the Quanta X Technology staff member you work with to request access, or request early access at bestdealon.app/app.

To install in Chrome: unzip the file you received, open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, click Load unpacked and choose the unzipped folder, then pin Best Deal On Bot. Create a free Best Deal On account, create an API token on your dashboard, and paste it into Best Deal On Bot under Business, Sync with bestdealon. Keep the folder where it is; to update, replace the folder and click reload.

Upgrading from Bizinator Backup: replace the files in the existing folder and click Reload; don't remove it, so your data is kept.

New business pages stay private until you click "I own this business" and an admin approves them. Best Deal On may verify a business phone number with an automated call and a one-time code.

Callbots phone assistant onboarding: a business signs up, turns on calls (texting turns on after a one-time carrier approval), and fills an empty knowledge base with Grok Bot's help.
